target_customer: Solar, storage and data center developers and their financiers
problem: Zoning, permitting and local sentiment research across thousands of jurisdictions is slow and unreliable. Spark's AI indexes documents so developers can see requirements and fatal flaws quickly.
business_model: Annual B2B subscription priced by seats and usage plus per report fees (company site)
product_category: AI permitting and site selection intelligence for energy infrastructure

founders.name: Julia Wu
education: Brown University, computer science and economics
founders.background_notes: Led Card Fraud, Growth and Rewards teams at Brex (YC page).

founders.name: Anuj Saigal
founders.background_notes: About a decade in energy infrastructure (YC page).

competitors.name: SolarAPP+
competitors.what: Free NREL built instant residential solar permitting portal for local governments
competitors.traction_then: Launched July 2021; adopted by many jurisdictions; adjacent, solves approval workflow rather than research

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting and structuring over a million heterogeneous local documents with LLMs and keeping them current is large scale data engineering with accuracy demands.

defensibility.rationale: A corpus covering tens of thousands of jurisdictions and expert reviewed reports is costly to rebuild, but general LLMs and new entrants can approach it.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sourced incumbent move found; the company positions itself against general AI chatbots.

market_need_then: Local permitting and moratoria were a recognized bottleneck for solar, storage and later data center buildouts; the company reports customers representing over 90 GW of pipeline and $30B of financing (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses sparkhq.ai, a suffix variant; spark.com style names are taken by many unrelated brands.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and credibility focused: Know where you can build

branding.community_and_virality: Podcast appearances (Soliverse, Clean Power Hour) and YC launch pages; no merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with SparkNotes, Spark AR and others; credibility comes from named customers rather than brand assets.

pivots.from: Workflow software for solar and storage developers
pivots.to: Permitting and stakeholder intelligence including data center siting
pivots.why: Expansion to data center permitting is shown by YC launch pages; no stated reason and the date is approximate

outcome_analysis: Spark graduated YC W24 with founders who combine software and energy industry experience and landed enterprise customers soon after Demo Day, including NextEra and Intersect Power per its site. The data center permitting boom is a tailwind. No verified funding round, exit or shutdown was found, so financial outcome is unknown.
notes: Job posts say Spark raised seed funding from tech and energy investors and one directory lists Night Labs as a backer, but no amount, date or release was found, so unverified and not recorded as a round. SolarAPP+ is adjacent rather than a direct rival. Pivot entry date is approximate.
